name: Zener diodes
summary: Diodes that hold a fixed voltage in reverse, used as simple references and clamps.
uses: Simple voltage reference or regulator for small loads
Over-voltage clamp to protect a circuit
Setting a battery cutoff point with a transistor
identify: Small glass or black diodes marked with a voltage (5V1, 12V) or a code like 1N4733 or BZX55C, on power supplies, chargers and control boards.
test: Forward it reads about 0.7V like any diode. To find the zener voltage, feed it from a higher supply through a 1 kΩ resistor and measure across it.
